title: Sokoban Co-Creation Lab
subtitle: Share ideas. Make changes. Give them a play.
formalLanguageLock: Language is locked after starting. Selecting “Start co-creating” starts your 20 minutes.
demoLanguageLock: Language is locked after co-creation starts.
demoLandingBody: Take a look. Want a different map? Generate another!
formalLandingBody: Take a look. Want a different map? Generate another!
draftLoadingBody: Getting the map ready and checking for a solution…
draftInitialGenerating: Getting the map ready and checking for a solution…
draftRegenerating: Preparing another map. This one stays until the new map is ready.
draftInitialFailed: This map couldn’t be prepared. Select “Generate another” to try again.
draftRegenerationFailed: The new map couldn’t be prepared. Your previous map is still here. Try generating another.
draftLegend: P Player · B Box · T Target · ~ Water
draftReconnecting: The connection was interrupted. Checking the result of your last action.
draftUnityUnavailable: Keep the original Unity game tab open, then try again.
draftProtocolUnavailable: The original Unity tab is unavailable or outdated. Reopen or refresh the game page before regenerating.
draftProtocolMismatch: Unity and the co-creation page use different bridge versions. Refresh the game page.
draftSessionMismatch: Unity is connected to a different co-creation session. Return from the current game session.
draftUnityNotReady: Unity is still loading. Wait for the game view to become ready, then try again.
draftReceiverNotReady: The regeneration controller is not ready yet. Wait a moment, then try again.
draftPrepareExpired: The regeneration handoff expired before delivery. Try again.
draftBlueprintUnavailable: The saved AI blueprint is unavailable. Start a new formal draft from Unity.
draftGenerationTimedOut: Unity could not finish generation within the safe time limit.
draftGenerationFailed: Unity could not generate a new draft from the selected parameters. Try again.
draftLlmFailed: The AI draft planner could not finish this request. Try generating another.
draftValidationFailed: Unity generated a candidate, but validation did not accept it.
embeddedOnlyTitle: Return to the original Unity game page
embeddedOnlyBody: Formal co-creation is available only inside the embedded workspace. This standalone page cannot regenerate, play, or enter the formal flow.
chatAriaLabel: Talk about the map with AI
versionHint: Stage 1, Stage 2… are saved versions of the same map. You can revisit them here.
discuss: What do you think of this version?
viewingHistory: You are viewing this historical Stage and its own conversation. Return to the current Stage to continue chatting.
progressHelpBody: Revisit open questions and your confirmed ideas here. Open Processed to revisit earlier questions.
whyUnderstand: Why I understand it this way
assessmentPending: AI is taking a look at the map…
assessmentPendingBody: Take a look around the map while the opening reply is being prepared.
noStageConversation: No conversation has been recorded for this Stage.
noStageConversationBody: Each Stage keeps only the discussion attached to that saved version.
chatRetryPending: The previous message did not finish. Retry it without creating a duplicate.
messagePlaceholder: Got an idea? Tell us what you’d like to discuss or change.
intentConflictPlaceholder: Choose which inclination to keep above before continuing the conversation.
challengeChoicePlaceholder: Choose Yes or No on the card above before continuing the conversation.
proposalRetryPlaceholder: Retry the unfinished proposal request to continue this topic.
proposalSupplementPlaceholder: Add a direction for this topic or reply with a suggested number…
binaryChoicePlaceholder: Choose A or B. Cancel this proposal to describe a different request.
binaryRevisionNeededPlaceholder: Cancel this proposal to describe a different request.
binarySavedChoicesRetry: Your choices are saved. Retry or cancel this proposal.
binarySavedRequestRetry: Your proposal request is saved. Retry or cancel this proposal.
requestProposalHint: Want a concrete plan? Turn this on, then send your idea. You decide whether to use the proposal.
sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
playOpenedInUnity: The selected Stage is opening in the Unity view.
playUnityUnavailable: The embedded Unity view is unavailable. The co-creation workspace remains open; retry from the original game page.
playSyncFailed: The Stage was completed, but the play result could not be synchronized. This attempt will be recorded as interrupted.
playLoadFailed: The selected Stage could not be loaded in Unity. Please review the Stage and try again.
entityLegend: P: Player · B1/B2: Boxes · T1/T2: Targets · ~: Water
previousVerified: The last saved version has a solution
draftUnchecked: Your unsaved changes have not been checked
editorHelpBody: Hover over a tool or tile to see what it means. Select a tool, then click a map tile to replace it. Save changes to create a new Stage.
editMode: Choose a tile, then click the map to edit. Save when you’re ready.
readOnlyMode: You’re viewing an earlier save. Select “Continue from this version” to edit from it.
lockedMode: This session has ended. The map can no longer be edited.
unsavedDraftRestored: Your unsaved map edits were restored after the workspace refresh.
saveHint: Saving creates a new Stage and keeps the earlier versions.
noPlayEvidence: Haven’t tried this version yet? Give it a play.
finalizeHint: After confirming, you cannot edit or continue chatting in this session. Next, leave a message for the other player.
confirmBody: After confirming, you cannot edit or continue chatting in this session. Next, leave a message for the other player.
intentionTitle: Leave a message for the other player
intentionQuestion: What would you like to say to the other player?
sessionCompleteBody: Your map and message are saved. Return to the original game page to continue.
demoCompleteBody: Your map and message are saved. This co-creation session is complete.
returnUnityUnavailable: The original Unity tab is no longer available. Return to that tab manually; do not open a new game page, because the match is stored in the original game instance.
deadlineWarningAnnouncement: Five minutes remain in the co-creation session.
deadlineCriticalAnnouncement: One minute remains in the co-creation session.
deadlineExpiredAnnouncement: Time is up. Please submit your final version.
proposalValid: The proposed map has a solution. Take a look at the changed tiles before deciding.
accept: Use this and save a new version
staleRevisionCard: Only the latest revision card can be acted on.
proposalStale: This proposal is based on an older Stage and is no longer active.
proposalAlreadySatisfied: The current map already contains this change.
proposalPreconditionFailed: The map has changed, so this proposal can no longer be used.
proposalUnbound: This old proposal is view-only. Please use the latest proposal.
proposalDisagreementActive: Resolve the active disagreement before using this proposal.
proposalAlreadyExecuted: This proposal has already been used once and is no longer active.
proposalChallenged: This proposal is paused while its challenge is being resolved.
proposalReason: Why I will change it this way
proposalBinaryVerified: Permissions, selected actions and solvability verified; experience needs playtesting.
proposalCompanionPending: This map is still a pending proposal. If you would rather adjust it yourself, reject it first and continue in the editor so the two sets of changes do not get mixed together.
proposalCompanionOffer: If this direction feels close to what you mean, you can also try a small edit in the same area and compare which version better matches the experience you want.
verifiedProposalMessage: I have organized this map proposal and checked its real before/after tile changes. It is still yours to review; I would first look at whether the highlighted cells really answer the direction we discussed before deciding whether to accept it.
verifiedProposalSummaryLong: Verified tile changes ({count} total): {details}. See the highlighted map cells for every location.
routeAriaLabel: Show route from row {fromRow}, column {fromColumn} to row {toRow}, column {toColumn}
cue.manual_edit: MANUAL EDIT · Try tweaking it yourself
cue.question: LET’S DISCUSS · Let’s talk this through
cue.intent: TENTATIVE INTENT · Am I getting your idea?
cue.clarification: NEEDS CLARIFICATION · Tell me a bit more
hint.busy: Your last action is still being processed. Please wait.
hint.playActive: Return here after your play attempt.
hint.closed: This session has ended. Editing and chat are closed.
hint.history: Return to the current Stage to edit or chat.
hint.noChanges: There are no new map changes to save.
hint.dirtyPlay: Save or discard your changes before playing.
hint.pending: Accept or reject the pending proposal before continuing.
hint.finalDirty: Save or discard your changes before choosing the final version.
hint.conflict: Choose which idea to keep before continuing the conversation.
hint.emptyMessage: Write your idea, then select Send.
hint.noVersion: The map is not ready yet. Please wait.
hint.binaryProposal: Choose A or B or cancel the current proposal before editing or saving the map.
hint.binaryDraftReset: Unsaved map changes are blocking A/B choices. Discard unsaved changes to reset the draft, then choose A/B or cancel the proposal.
tileHelp.water: Water that the player cannot walk through.
tileHelp.player: The player’s starting position during play.
tileHelp.box: A box to push onto a target. B1 and B2 distinguish the boxes.
tileHelp.target: A target position for a box. T1 and T2 distinguish the targets.
tileHelp.erase: Empty space outside the map, not walkable floor.
help.tilePalette: Select this tool, then click the map to place it. Save your changes separately.
help.tileStagePreview: Click the thumbnail to view this version’s map, conversation, and play history.
help.tilePreview: This is a preview tile, for viewing only.
help.tileDisabled: This tile cannot be edited right now.
help.tileEditable: Click to replace this tile with the selected {tool} tool.
help.stageBody: View this version’s map, conversation, and play history.
help.stageDirtyWarning: Switching discards unsaved changes, so save them first.
help.routeBody: Show the route described by this text on the map. Click again to hide it.
help.setupLanguage: Choose the language for this session. It cannot be changed after co-creation starts.
help.regenerateDraft: Prepare another starting map. The current preview stays until the new map is ready.
help.enterSession: Start co-creating with this starting map. It becomes Stage 1.
help.play: Play the selected saved version, then return here to continue.
help.saveStage: Save your changes as a new Stage. Earlier saved versions are kept.
help.discardDraft: Discard unsaved map changes and return to the selected saved map.
help.restoreStage: Create a new Stage from this earlier map and continue editing. The earlier version is kept.
help.finalize: Choose the version you are viewing as the final version. Confirmation ends editing and chat; your message comes next.
help.confirmFinalize: Confirm the final version. Editing and chat will close; next, write your message to the other player.
help.cancelFinalize: Leave the final choice open and return to the map.
help.send: Send your message. If proposal mode is on, this message requests a modification plan.
help.proposalRequest: Choose whether your next message requests a plan. Switching this on does not send anything or change the map.
help.returnCurrent: Return to the latest Stage to continue the current conversation and editing.
help.returnUnity: Return to the original game page to continue the match.
help.retry: Retry the unfinished action using its captured content.
help.chatRetry: Retry the unfinished message with the same text and proposal setting.
help.completeSession: Save your message and finish this co-creation session.
help.draftSuggestedRevision: Prepare the proposed map preview. A new Stage is created only after you explicitly accept the pending proposal.
help.challengeRevision: Tell AI you see this plan differently, then explain your concerns in the conversation.
help.alternativeRevision: Ask AI for a different proposal. This does not directly replace the current map.
help.accept: Accept the pending map proposal and save it as a new Stage.
help.reject: Reject the pending proposal and keep the current map.
help.intentMatches: Say this interpretation matches your idea. This feedback does not authorize a map edit.
help.intentReject: Say this interpretation is not what you meant. This does not change the map.
help.intentAdjust: Open the text field to explain your idea more precisely.
help.intentModify: Edit this recorded design idea and submit the adjustment.
help.intentSave: Submit your adjusted idea. This does not automatically edit the map.
help.intentCancel: Close this text adjustment without submitting it.
help.intentKeepThis: Choose to keep the idea on this card. This does not edit the map.
help.ignoreQuestion: Move this question to Processed and leave it out of later conversation. You can restore it manually.
help.restoreQuestion: Restore this question to the open questions.
help.challengeChoice: Answer the question in the discussion above. This choice does not itself create a new Stage.
help.cancelProposal: Cancel the current proposal flow so you can describe a different request.
errors.GENERIC: The request could not be completed.
errors.NO_SESSION: Open this lab from Unity or start a sample session.
errors.DIRTY_PLAY: Save or discard the map draft before playing.
errors.PENDING_PLAY: Accept or reject the pending map proposal before playing.
errors.INTENT_REQUIRED: Leave a message before finishing this session.
errors.CONTEXT_CHANGED: The conversation has changed. Send your request based on the current dialogue. This request did not change the map.
errors.CLARIFICATION_REVIEW_FAILED: The proposal clarification review could not be verified. Retry the original message safely.
errors.REPLY_FAILED: This reply couldn’t be completed. Please retry.
errors.MODIFICATION_FAILED: These changes did not pass the checks. The map was not changed.
errors.OLD_PROPOSAL: This proposal is no longer available. Please check the latest proposal.
errors.NO_PROPOSAL: No suitable proposal was found. The map was not changed.
errors.INVALID_HEIGHT: The map must contain exactly 10 rows.
errors.INVALID_WIDTH: Every map row must contain exactly 12 tiles.
errors.UNKNOWN_TILE: The map contains an unsupported tile symbol.
errors.INVALID_PLAYER_COUNT: The map must contain exactly one player.
errors.INVALID_BOX_COUNT: The map must contain one or two boxes.
errors.MISMATCHED_TARGET_COUNT: The number of targets must match the number of boxes.
errors.UNSOLVABLE_LEVEL: No solution was found for this map. Please check the map.
errors.SEARCH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The check could not finish, so we cannot yet confirm whether this map has a solution.
errors.OPEN_OUTER_WALL: The outer boundary must be closed with wall (#) tiles; water cannot replace a wall.
errors.CLIENT_TIMEOUT: The assistant did not finish within the browser safety limit. You can retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: Kimi did not finish within the response limit. Retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_ERROR: Kimi is temporarily unreachable. Retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.UPSTREAM_SERVER_ERROR: Kimi temporarily could not complete the response. Retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT: The model service is temporarily rate-limited. Retry safely without creating a duplicate.
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: The upstream model service encountered a temporary error. Retry safely without creating a duplicate.
errors.UPSTREAM_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: The upstream model service authentication failed. Please try again later or contact the coordinator.
errors.UPSTREAM_REQUEST_REJECTED: The upstream model service rejected this request. Please adjust your message and try again.
errors.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The request exceeded its safe processing time limit. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_EMPTY_RESPONSE: The latest model attempt returned blank content. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The model output was truncated before finishing. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_JSON_INVALID: The model returned malformed structured output. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_SCHEMA_INVALID: The model response did not match the expected structure. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_VALIDATION_FAILED: The model response failed validation checks. Retry without creating a duplicate.
errors.MODEL_RESPONSE_INVALID: Kimi could not reliably verify this request or reply. Retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.MODEL_LOW_QUALITY_RESPONSE: Kimi did not produce a reliable reply within this request's budget. Retry without creating a duplicate message.
errors.RETRYABLE_REQUEST_FAILED: The request was interrupted or the server returned an unreadable error. Retry the same message without creating a duplicate.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The server response was incomplete or unreadable. Retry the original operation.
errors.INVALID_MESSAGE_ACTION: That card action is invalid. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_CARD_SOURCE: That revision card no longer belongs to the current Stage. Refresh and choose the current card.
errors.TURN_NOT_FOUND: The referenced conversation turn could not be found. Refreshing the current Stage.
errors.STALE_REVISION_BINDING: This revision card no longer matches the current Stage. Refresh and check the latest card.
errors.UNBOUND_REVISION: This revision card has no executable map changes bound to it.
errors.PROPOSAL_STALE: This proposal is based on an older Stage or map snapshot and is no longer active.
errors.STALE_PROPOSAL: This proposal is no longer pending or belongs to an earlier Stage.
errors.PROPOSAL_PRECONDITION_FAILED: The map has changed, so this proposal can no longer be used.
errors.PROPOSAL_SEARCH_EXHAUSTED: No verified map proposal could be produced for this direction. The current map was not changed.
errors.DETERMINISTIC_SEARCH_EXHAUSTED: No verified proposal was found. The map was not changed.
errors.SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINT_NOT_MET: No candidate satisfied every explicit requirement; the current map was not changed.
errors.REVISION_EXECUTION_INVALID: The frozen revision did not pass the internal execution-contract check. The current map was not changed.
errors.REVISION_EXECUTION_MISMATCH: The replayed revision did not match its frozen tile changes. The current map was not changed.
errors.SEMANTIC_POSTCONDITION_FAILED: The reviewed proposal failed its semantic postcondition and was not applied.
errors.EXECUTION_REPLAY_MISMATCH: The actual diff no longer matches the reviewed purple card and was not applied.
errors.CANDIDATE_UNSOLVABLE: The candidates did not pass solvability validation. The map was not changed.
errors.CANDIDATE_DUPLICATED: No different proposal was found. The current map was not changed.
errors.DISAGREEMENT_ACTIVE: Discuss the current difference of views before choosing another proposal.
errors.REQUIREMENT_INTERPRETATION_INVALI: The requested changes could not be understood reliably. Retry the original message.
errors.REQUIREMENT_EVIDENCE_MISSING: The original requirement evidence could not be restored. Retry the original message.
errors.REQUIREMENT_PERMISSION_CONFLICT: This direction goes beyond the allowed changes. Please adjust the idea.
errors.CHALLENGE_REVIEW_FAILED: Kimi could not judge this reason reliably. Retry the message.
errors.CHALLENGE_REVIEW_RETRY_RETIRED: Use the chat request retry for this judgment.
errors.CHALLENGE_EXIT_UNSUPPORTED: Continue the conversation to resolve this proposal challenge.
errors.CHALLENGE_STALE: This proposal challenge is no longer active. Refresh to view the current conversation.
errors.CHALLENGE_REVIEW_BUSY: The challenge reason is still being reviewed. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.STALE_INTENT_CARD: This intent card was already handled or is no longer current.
errors.INTENT_HYPOTHESIS_STALE: This design inclination card was already handled or is no longer current.
errors.INVALID_INTENT_FEEDBACK: Enter a clear design inclination between 4 and 1200 characters.
errors.INTENT_CONFLICT_PENDING: Choose which conflicting inclination to keep before sending another message.
errors.INTENT_CONTEXT_CHANGED: Confirmed inclination memory changed during review. Retry this message.
errors.STALE_QUESTION: This question is no longer available for that action.
errors.QUESTION_FEEDBACK_STALE: This question is no longer active for that action.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The current Stage has changed. Refresh before continuing.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This action could not be completed. Start it again.
errors.UNCHANGED_LEVEL: The map has not changed and cannot be saved as a new Stage.
errors.PENDING_PROPOSAL: Accept or reject the pending map proposal before continuing.
errors.PROPOSAL_PENDING: Accept or reject the pending map proposal before continuing.
errors.SESSION_LOCKED: This co-creation session is locked and can no longer be edited.
errors.SESSION_DEADLINE_EXPIRED: The co-creation time limit has expired. Editing and chat are closed; submit the final version.
errors.ONLINE_INTENTION_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE: Your intention was saved, but the online match could not be updated yet. Retry submitting the same intention.
errors.ONLINE_INTENTION_SYNC_REJECTED: Your intention was saved, but the online match rejected the sync payload.
errors.ONLINE_FLOW_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE: The co-creation state was saved, but synchronization to the online match failed temporarily. Please retry.
errors.ONLINE_FLOW_SYNC_REJECTED: The co-creation state was saved, but the online match rejected its synchronization payload.
errors.SESSION_ACCESS_DENIED: This browser does not have access to this co-creation session.
errors.INVALID_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: This session link is invalid. Re-open the lab from Unity.
errors.BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_USED: This session link has already been used. Continue in the original browser tab.
errors.INVALID_PLAY_TICKET: This play link is unavailable. Return to the workspace and select Play again.
errors.PLAY_TICKET_USED: This play link has been used. Return to the workspace and select Play again.
errors.PLAY_TICKET_EXPIRED: This play link has expired. Return to the workspace and select Play again.
errors.CONFIGURATION_ERROR: Replies are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.PROPOSAL_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Choose option A or B above, or cancel this proposal before sending a message.
errors.BINARY_BUSY: This proposal is still being processed. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.PROPOSAL_TRANSLATION_STALE: The proposal options were updated. Refresh and choose again.
errors.BINARY_PROMISE_NOT_REALIZED: The candidate edit did not realize your selected direction. The current map was not changed.
errors.BINARY_DIRECTIONS_UNAVAILABLE: Two distinct verified directions could not be prepared right now. The current map was not changed.
errors.BINARY_PREFLIGHT_BUDGET: Proposal preflight reached its time limit before finishing. Retry safely or cancel this proposal.
errors.BINARY_PLANNING_BUDGET: Proposal planning reached its time limit before finishing. Retry safely or cancel this proposal.
errors.BINARY_VALIDATION_FAILED: The proposal candidate did not pass map validation and solvability checks. The map was not changed.
errors.BINARY_SEMANTIC_REJECTED: The proposal candidate did not satisfy the selected requirements. The map was not changed.
errors.UNSAFE_NAVIGATION_URL: The play destination URL was blocked for safety.
